Tools I Build

Software
MYELIN SYNTH by salxis

MYELIN SYNTH is a synthesizer plugin I designed and built from scratch in C++/JUCE — full DSP engine, custom UI, and preset system, running as a VST inside FL Studio.

Beyond sound design, I built the plugin's entire interface myself: a flat console-style layout with a real-time L/R goniometer (stereo correlation scope) as the visual centerpiece, plus a drag-and-drop layout editor so any knob can be repositioned and saved to a custom layout.

Custom DSP signal chain with headroom-aware drive and filter envelope
Factory preset browser with save, delete, and rename
Real-time stereo goniometer built from live audio ring buffers
Runtime drag-and-drop layout editor with persistent custom layouts
C++ JUCE VST3 DSP UI/UX

Background

Bio

I hold an associate degree in Audio Engineering from Full Sail University, where I trained on Avid and Yamaha consoles and built a foundation in tracking, mixing, and studio signal flow.

Since then I've spent years producing and engineering music independently, working with small and emerging artists online — writing, producing, and mixing records from first idea to final bounce.

My main environment is Pro Tools, and I'm comfortable owning a session end to end: production, editing, mixing, and delivering a finished master.
